name: Anfractuos
storyline:
Deep in space lies Anfractuos - a thick crusted planetoid once mined for its valuable
deposits of Cryanium. But the solar system it is in has become unstable and it is
feared that its sun is about to go supernova. All humans have been evacuated and all
that is left behind are the mines and an abandoned mining droid trying to escape.

In order to escape he must collect 8 fuel cans to enable the shuttle to blast to safety,
but it won't be easy! The wildlife is composed of negative energy and any contact will
deplete your energy cells, but they're a protected species so be careful when you shoot
them or you'll pay for it later. You can replenish your energy pack from power points
around the mine and use lifts units, but due to lackof maintenance the equipment is
starting to malfunction.

The escape shuttle is restrained by 4 switches which have to be found and disabled -
an operation which will start a countdown reaction, so hurry back or it will leave
without you!
summary:
You're doomed to destruction - the only way out is by shuttle. Collect
8 fuel cans, find and destroy the launch retainer switches and blast off.
But hurry - there's not much time!
